info.title: OpenCITE Scholarly Search API
info.description: One deduped, citation-ready call across 250M+ open-access papers plus museum, library, manuscript and Islamicate archives. Each result names its source database and carries DOI/URL provenance and formatted citations (MLA, APA, BibTeX, RIS, CSL-JSON). Results keep each source's native relevance order, interleaved scholarly-first. Billed 1 credit per call, prorated by the coverage actually delivered; requires an x-api-key header.

get.summary: Search open-access scholarly, museum and archive sources in one call.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query (max 512 chars). Separate up to 5 keywords with ';'.

schema.description: Search query (max 512 chars). Separate up to 5 keywords with ';'.

parameters.name: sources
parameters.description: Advanced: comma-separated subset of source IDs (as returned in each result's `source`) to restrict the search to. Unknown ids are ignored. Omit to search the full available library (recommended).

schema.description: Advanced: comma-separated subset of source IDs (as returned in each result's `source`) to restrict the search to. Unknown ids are ignored. Omit to search the full available library (recommended).

parameters.name: authors
parameters.description: 1/true to include author-name matches in retrieval.

schema.description: 1/true to include author-name matches in retrieval.

parameters.name: cite
parameters.description: Extra citation formats per result, comma-separated: bibtex, ris, csl-json.

schema.description: Extra citation formats per result, comma-separated: bibtex, ris, csl-json.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: json (default, structured cards) | mla | apa | bibtex | ris | csl-json (non-json returns a flat bibliography of the returned results).

schema.description: json (default, structured cards) | mla | apa | bibtex | ris | csl-json (non-json returns a flat bibliography of the returned results).

200.description: Deduped result cards in native upstream order, interleaved scholarly-first; each names its source.

coverage.description: Corpus-weighted coverage band for this request: one of full, near-full, high, partial, limited.

totalCandidates.description: Total deduped candidates considered before the limit.

id.description: Opaque, deterministic result identifier (prefix oc_). Not an upstream id.

source.description: Upstream database that served this record (e.g. OPENALEX, CROSSREF, DOAJ, NCBI, EUROPEANA).

isOA.description: Whether the work is open access.

citedBy.description: Citation count, when the work carries one (else null).

citations.description: Formatted citations: { mla, apa, …extra requested formats }.

results.description: Array of origin-blind result cards (see fields below).

meta.description: Billing metadata: { creditsCharged, balance } — credits spent on this call (coverage-prorated; 0 for unmetered tiers) and the caller's remaining balance.

400.description: Invalid request (e.g. no valid sources selected).

401.description: Invalid or missing x-api-key header (a key is always required).

402.description: Insufficient credits — body carries { code: "insufficient_credits", upgrade_url }.

429.description: Rate limited (per key, and per IP before auth). Retry-After header set.
